regions.merged_text: God bless you. I hope you are well. Strange ... the herewith enclosed Xmas card! I only just came across it Tonight - now almost 11 P.M. I just thought I'd send it anyway. I was talking to-night (by phone) to same M. Casey therin mentioned. She is well, expecting Mildred here this week .... - tells me she expects to go to California before long .... Mrs. E. Sampson was in last Sunday. E'd - Sr. & Jr. are well also E'd III. Old Mr. Doonan was in some time ago and seems pretty well. I had dinner Xmas at Molloys. James is doing well - 2nd yr. in Sacred Heart Seminary. Our prophet, Father Coughlin, started again last Sunday on the air in a touching tribute to Bishop Gallagher.
